ChangedDecoders: Micro QR M1 validates both error-detection codewords without repairing the data. This rejects a spurious M1 payload on an Aztec image before the default scanner can stop at its first result.

Larger Micro QR symbols retain their documented correction capacity, including reserved misdecode-protection codewords. Changes in both data and parity count against that capacity; generic Reed-Solomon behavior is unchanged.
Existing Micro QR module, pixel and encoded-image entry points share the acceptance rule. No public entry point, production dependency, recognition allowance or corpus oracle changes.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 207/267 correct positive images versus 205/267 in the previous pass. Previously correct images lost: none; gained: code128-1/1.png, code128-1/5.png. Paired negative completion is [24, 29, 30, 30]/31 with the current binary and [30, 29, 30, 30]/31 with the previous qualified binary. All outcomes remain sensitive to shared-host contention and wall-clock budgets; no universal timeout or recognition advantage is established. Micro QR validation rejects measured false acceptance without changing total or family recognition allowances. Additional default-format Aztec checks are contract diagnostics, not a representative accuracy survey or performance comparison. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by prior remediation, not an unseen holdout. The invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracle and undeclared QR character encoding policies remain unchanged in scoring. Stacked DataBar and Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported. The Code 128 comparison hint includes GS1-128, matching the physical family in both ZXing readers. Two exact-image gains over the previous pass follow from this hint correction; input hashes, oracles and payload scoring remain unchanged.

RegressionProof.Coverage: M1 rejects damaged payload and parity; every larger Micro QR version/ECC retains its correction boundary. An independent BWIPP M1 image decodes. Micro QR rejects the Historico Aztec image and default-format robust scanning returns only the correct Aztec payload at MaxSymbols 1 and 32. Existing Micro QR and Aztec contracts remain qualified.
